notes: Mounted combat for GROUND mounts only (12_Systems/mounted_combat.md; Canon: no flying, celestial, dragon or aquatic mounts, no mounting in interior dungeons). This file ADDS to the limits already in Data/Companions/mounts.json mountedCombat (banned skill tags big/aerial/channelled, reach cap 2.5 m, damage x0.85, 3 chain hits, stagger dismounts the rider, no interior); it never repeats or overrides them except through the explicit per-weapon-family exceptions below. All numbers are PROPOSALS for the user to tune. No Core or Unity code reads this file yet.

mountStamina.notes: The mount stamina block in mounts.json also pays for combat moves. Area attacks (ground zones, shockwaves) drain a share; at zero the rider is set down gently (no damage, no stagger) and mounted bonuses stop until the mount recovers. The mount is never killed (mounts.json knockoutOnly).

wf_sword.note: Sword hits from the saddle: the baseline mounted fighter.

wf_greatsword.note: One wide swing per pass; the second hit never starts.

wf_twin_blades.note: Cross slashes, two hits: speed is spent on the mount.

wf_katana.note: Counter Draw stays: the wider parry window works from the saddle.

wf_sword_shield.note: Guarding works mounted; Shield Wall and Earth Stomp are banned (big).

wf_polearm.note: The mounted weapon: reach exception to 3.4 m, and the charge adds x1.4 power.

wf_daggers.note: Short reach; backstab only from the mount's flank pass.

wf_bow.note: Mounted archery: free aim works at a wider reticle drift; ranged shots are not melee reach.

wf_caster_focus.note: Bolts only; Frost Nova, Fireball and every channelled cast are banned while mounted.

wf_censer_mace.note: Strikes and Holy Light; Sanctuary (a planted ward) is banned.

wf_fists.note: Fists need the ground under you; a punch from the saddle does not read.

wf_whip_rod.note: Whip lashes work well mounted (wide reach exception, 3 m); Swap with the mount is not a companion swap.

wf_instrument.note: Chord Strikes only: songs are channelled and banned mounted.

wf_workshop.note: Hammer swings and deployables need footing.
